posts.title: The birth process is negative binomial
Feige’s conjecture
posts.description: Let $X_1, X_2, \dots, X_n$ be independent random variables, each with mean at most 1. We want to maximise the probability that their sum $S = \sum_{i=1}^n X_i$ is at least $n + \delta$ for some $\delta > 0$. How do we do this?
